assign.outcome: **critique-full-v1 stays the default prompt.** Ran critique-v1 (short) and a new checklist-v1 (targeted, 9-item yes/no) on the 6 pilot pages @1280, Sonnet, same run — 12 shots, $0.93 actual (est $0.86, ceiling $2). critique-full-v1: 4.83 findings/shot, $0.087 avg, catches things the other two miss even on identical images (a mislabeled duplicate sidebar link, a card with no background). checklist-v1 reliably catches edge-cramping and unlabeled controls full-v1 sometimes skips; critique-v1 (short) is cheapest but overcalls "broken". Wrote critique-full-v2.md: one line changed (`skip the ones that don't apply` -> `touch every angle, even to dismiss it`) — the smallest evidence-backed fix, not adopted as default yet. Also found and fixed a real bug: run.mjs OVERWRITES prompts.json each run instead of merging, silently dropping earlier prompts' text — repaired by hand for this run dir, flagged for a follow-up (not fixed in run.mjs per the file fence). --resume-run keys on hash only (not prompt_id) so it would wrongly skip a re-ask under a new prompt_id — worked around by omitting it (free Playwright recapture) rather than editing run.mjs.
